name: ghost
description: Ghost: Cursor Tab for your whole computer

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,demo,ext -c blue,green,magenta "pnpm --filter @ghost/server dev" "pnpm --filter @ghost/demo dev" "pnpm --filter @ghost/extension dev"
scripts.test:terminal: if command -v zsh >/dev/null 2>&1; then zsh -f terminal/tests/ghost.test.zsh; else echo 'test:terminal skipped: zsh is not installed'; fi
